about.label: 01 - About me
about.title: Professional profile

profile.summary: Fullstack developer since 2020, specialized in PHP/Symfony on the server side and React.js / Angular on the client side. I work across the full project cycle: requirements definition, database design, development and release, in an Agile/Scrum environment. I have worked on business platforms such as SCOPLAN, which streamlines management, tracking and communication between a construction contractor and its client, as well as an e-commerce marketplace and real estate applications. I code to TDD, SOLID and OOP standards, with Docker and Git as part of my daily workflow.

scoplanV2.description: Migration of SCOPLAN to version 2, a platform that streamlines management, tracking and communication between a construction contractor and its client. scoplan.description: Development of SCOPLAN (www.scoplan.com), a construction project management and tracking platform. Fullstack work on Symfony 3/4 and React.js, with Twig, jQuery, MySQL and REST APIs, in a Docker environment on Linux.

esokia.description: Development of the ABANA marketplace (abana.mu) with Symfony 4, API Platform and React.js. Frontend integration in HTML5/CSS3, REST APIs and MySQL database in a containerised environment.

freelance.description: Designed and built the Trading, Teambuilding and S-Manager projects for direct clients. Symfony 4/5 stack with API Platform and React.js, MySQL database, Docker and REST APIs, from requirements gathering through to delivery.
